summary: Share link temporal dead zone bug fix verified. The bug was: useEffect at line 110 referenced `displayFiles` in its dependency array, but `displayFiles` was declared at line 313 (temporal dead zone = ReferenceError crash). Fix: moved the useEffect to line 299 (after displayFiles declaration at line 298). All backend and frontend tests pass - share links work correctly, heartbeat feature works, live-visitors endpoint returns data.
